rnp_style_contract.candidate_universe: drug-like ligands in the same retained top-25 Foldseek PDB hits used by the Foldarium audit
rnp_style_contract.ligand_similarity: 0.5 * pharmacophore feature-map score + 0.5 * (1 - shape protrude distance)
omitted_paper_components: Foldseek sensitivity-11 search with up to 5000 candidates
maximum of Foldseek and MMseqs directional pocket coverage
PLIP interacting-residue augmentation of 6A geometric pockets
multi-chain greedy matching and multi-ligand pocket denominator

rnp_style_contract.pocket_qcov: fraction of query 6A pocket residues whose Foldseek-aligned target residue lies in the training ligand's 6A pocket
